card.name: Secrecy and concealment in the text
card.fires_on: Words in stories or reports about hidden or secret acts, such as burying money, keeping something quiet, sneaking, stealing secrets, or marrying in secret. It fires on the word just before or at the point of secrecy.

modes.label: Hidden actions
modes.description: Verbs or adverbs describing doing something covertly, like burying, sneaking or stealing.
modes.example: The temptation was too great for his honesty, and he<< buried>> the money, probably intending to quietly slip

modes.label: Keeping things quiet
modes.description: Words in phrases about keeping a project or fact unannounced.
modes.example: It may want to keep it<< quiet>>, but South Korea is developing a modern

modes.label: Secret programs
modes.description: Words inside reports about secret weapons programs or espionage.
modes.example: A secret unit (Unit 840) has been making enriched uranium since 19<<7>>9-80 on a production scale

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning secret or hidden, such as secretly, covert and clandestine, so the output is less likely to repeat that idea.
card.plain: It lights up where a text is about something done in secret, and it pushes the model away from saying secret-type words next.
